customer.title: Customer Data
customer.desc: Your tenant-wide contact pool built from participants and institutions — the single address book for e-mail, SMS and WhatsApp dispatch. Manual single entry is always available; there is no single data source.
customer.needEdition: An event must be selected for this action
customer.emptyDesc: Import from participants or add a manual single entry — records accumulate tenant-wide.
customer.sendSingleTitle: Send a single notification to this person/institution
customer.manualDesc: Add a customer contact from off-form sources (phone, e-mail, field). A matching e-mail/phone is rejected with 409 — no duplicates.
customer.fOptInHint: Campaigns are not sent to non-consenting contacts (GDPR/KVKK minimum).
customer.needContact: At least one of e-mail or phone is required
customer.importDesc: Participations of the selected event are converted into customer data. Rows matching by e-mail/phone are not recreated — the existing contact is enriched.
customer.importTagHint: The tag is used in segment filters.
customer.importCategoriesHint: If empty, all participants are imported.
customer.importNote: Participants without contact info (no e-mail and no phone) are skipped and shown in the report.
customer.importDoneDesc: {created} new contacts, {merged} existing records enriched, {skipped} skipped.
customer.sendDesc: A single-recipient notification is sent to this contact; the send is archived in the phase hierarchy.

instant.title: Send Instant Notification
instant.desc: Program change, room/bus change, last-minute announcement… Sent simultaneously to one person or a bulk audience via e-mail, SMS and WhatsApp; archived as a campaign in the Pre/During/Post Event hierarchy.
instant.noCategories: No categories in this event — all participants are targeted.
instant.fCustomPh: line or comma separated: e-mail / phone
instant.customHint: Lines in e-mail format go to e-mail, the rest to phone.
instant.fBodyPh: Short and clear notification text — mind length on SMS/WhatsApp.
instant.fPortalHint: Pushes an urgent announcement to the attendee mobile portal home.
instant.audInvalid: Fill the required fields for the selected audience.
instant.sentDesc: Delivered to {total} recipients — it will appear in the campaign archive.

camp.channelsHint: You can select multiple channels — each channel reaches recipients who have the corresponding detail.
camp.audCustomerOnlyHint: Targets the tenant-wide contact pool instead of event participation.
camp.testBtnTitle: Send only to the test recipient
camp.testDesc: The real audience list is untouched; only the test recipient below receives it.
camp.testChannelHint: For SMS/WhatsApp tests the channel configuration (General Communication channels) must be active.
camp.sentNoChannel: No recipient/channel could be reached — see the report on the card.
